I welcome today’s proposal from the OCC and FDIC to restore a more practical Community Reinvestment Act framework. Community banks should be focused on expanding access to credit, supporting small businesses, and strengthening local communities, not navigating unnecessary regulatory burdens or subsidizing activist causes. 

This proposal is an important step toward ensuring CRA resources are directed where Congress intended: helping the communities they are meant to serve.
posts.summary: Supports deregulation of Community Reinvestment Act framework

The Daughters of the American Revolution are called ‘Daughters’ for a reason—this organization is meant to honor the legacy of American women and their ancestors, not pander to a distorted sense of reality manufactured by far-left radical Democrats.

Tonight, an overwhelming majority of my Senate colleagues and I advanced sanctions legislation at a critical juncture in this war: where Russia is the weakest it’s been in years.

The time is now to honor Senator Lindsey Graham’s legacy by giving President Trump the economic firepower he needs to end Putin’s war of aggression and hold Tehran accountable for fueling 47 years of terrorism across the globe. 

Let’s get this done.

As I have always stated, I will stay in Washington and work as long as it takes to get the job done.

Right now, our work is getting the SAVE America Act passed, the Russia-Iran Sanctions bill passed, confirming President Trump’s nominees, and preventing another Democratic shutdown before the August state work period. 

Our job is to work for the people who sent us here and deliver results. End of story.
